in_marathi.name: Anju
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anju is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘An’ meaning grace and ‘Ju’ meaning favor. This name is considered to be a symbol of blessings, kindness and compassion. In Hindu mythology, Anju is the name of the divine mother who is believed to bestow her blessings upon her children. It is also the name of the goddess of fertility and prosperity.
